blocks.html: Expansion Revenue is the additional revenue generated from existing customers through upselling, cross-selling, add-ons, or contract upgrades.

Expansion revenue reflects growth within the existing customer base and is a key indicator of customer satisfaction and product value. Rather than relying solely on new customer acquisition, businesses leverage expansion strategies to increase revenue from current relationships.
Expansion revenue is driven by identifying opportunities to provide more value to existing customers, such as:

items.title: Upselling:
items.html: Qualification of the Encouraging customers to upgrade to higher-tier plans prospect

items.title: Contract expansions:
items.html: Increasing usage, seats, or subscription levels

blocks.html: Drives revenue growth without high acquisition costs
These strategies are often supported by customer success teams, usage data, and personalized engagement.
A SaaS company upgrades an existing client from a basic plan to an enterprise package while also adding new features and user licenses, resulting in increased recurring revenue.

Expansion revenue is a powerful growth lever that maximizes the value of existing customers. By focusing on delivering additional value, businesses can drive sustainable revenue growth and stronger customer relationships.
